record.paper_title: Open problems posed at the tenth International conference on fuzzy set theory and applications (FSTA 2010, Liptovsky Jan, Slovakia)
record.original_question: For a fixed triangular norm T0 and triangular conorm S0, characterize all pairs (T,S), where T is a triangular norm and S is a triangular conorm, satisfying T(x,y)+S(x,y)=T0(x,y)+S0(x,y) for every x,y in [0,1]. This generalizes the Frank functional equation, which is obtained when T0 is one of the Lukasiewicz, product, or minimum triangular norms and S0 is its dual.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
A triangular norm is a binary operation $T:[0,1]^2\to[0,1]$ that is commutative, associative, monotone non-decreasing in each argument, and satisfies $T(x,1)=x$ for all $x\in[0,1]$. A triangular conorm is a binary operation $S:[0,1]^2\to[0,1]$ that is commutative, associative, monotone non-decreasing in each argument, and satisfies $S(x,0)=x$ for all $x\in[0,1]$.

The classical Frank functional equation seeks all pairs $(T,S)$ consisting of a triangular norm $T$ and a triangular conorm $S$ such that
$$T(x,y)+S(x,y)=x+y\qquad\text{for all }x,y\in[0,1],$$
which corresponds to the case where $T_0=T_{\mathbf{M}}$ (the minimum), $T_0=T_{\mathbf{P}}$ (the product), or $T_0=T_{\mathbf{L}}$ (the Łukasiewicz t-norm $\max(x+y-1,0)$), and $S_0$ is its dual conorm $S_0(x,y)=1-T_0(1-x,1-y)$.

Generalized problem. Fix an arbitrary triangular norm $T_0$ and an arbitrary triangular conorm $S_0$. Characterize all pairs $(T,S)$, where $T$ is a triangular norm and $S$ is a triangular conorm, satisfying
$$T(x,y)+S(x,y)=T_0(x,y)+S_0(x,y)\qquad\text{for all }x,y\in[0,1].$$
artifact.status_search_result: Several follow-up works in the fuzzy-logic/copula literature address generalizations of the Frank functional equation, including a "note on a generalized Frank functional equation" and works on convex-linear T–S functions and the Frank inequality. These provide partial characterizations (e.g., associative copulas satisfying the Frank inequality must be Frank copulas or certain ordinal sums, and broader associative aggregation versions yield only two extra solutions, the projections), but no complete characterization for arbitrary fixed $(T_0,S_0)$ appears to be established.

status_evidence.title: A note on a generalized Frank functional equation
status_evidence.snippet: A further generalization of the Frank functional equation in the framework of associative binary aggregation functions.
status_evidence.claim: Partial progress on generalized Frank equation, yielding only limited new solutions beyond the classical case.

status_evidence.title: Convex linear T–S functions: A generalization of Frank's equation
status_evidence.snippet: Generalization of Frank's equation via convex linear combinations of a t-norm and a t-conorm.
status_evidence.claim: Studies a related generalized Frank-type equation, providing partial characterizations.

status_evidence.title: The Frank inequality
status_evidence.snippet: Associative copulas satisfying the Frank inequality are Frank copulas or ordinal sums of a same Frank copula with equidistant idempotent elements.
status_evidence.claim: Related characterization result under an inequality version.
